stories.headline: Mitchells & Butlers: CFO Designate Emma Harris Joins Firm, Tim Jones To Retire On July 6
stories.body: (RTTNews) - Mitchells & Butlers (MLB, MAB.L, MBPFF), an operator of managed restaurants and pubs, said Friday that Chief Financial Officer designate Emma Harris joined the firm on April 20.

stories.headline: Texas Capital, buoyed by turnaround, to pay first-ever dividend
stories.body: The Dallas bank continues to advance a multiyear transformation strategy. On Thursday it laid out plans to expand its newly revamped private banking and family office business.
